id: title:jabahamondes:sync performance max search terms from google ads

review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse ingestion support for Google Ads Performance Max campaign search term metrics, enabling PostHog warehouse users to store and query search term performance data.
review.reason: The change adds a new warehouse resource and associated stats column group for Google Ads Performance Max campaign search term views. P1.F1.H1 introduces the metrics (clicks, impressions, cost, conversions) and P1.F2.H1 establishes the warehouse resource and filtering.
